document: DS12766 Rev 3 - Table 67. LQFP32 - Mechanical data
title: Table 67. LQFP32 - Mechanical data
text_helper: Table 67. LQFP32 - Mechanical data — section 6.1 Device marking. Symbol, millimeters / Min, millimeters / Typ, millimeters / Max, inches(14) / Min, +2 autres.

notes: 1. Dimensioning and tolerancing schemes conform to ASME Y14.5M-1994.
2. The top package body size may be smaller than the bottom package size by as much as 0.15 mm.
4. To be determined at the seating datum plane C.
5. Dimensions D1 and E1 do not include mold flash or protrusions. Allowable mold flash or protrusions is “0.25 mm” per side. D1 and E1 are maximum plastic body size
9. Dimension b does not include a dambar protrusion. Allowable dambar protrusion shall not cause the lead width to exceed the maximum “b” dimension by more than 0.08 mm.
11. These dimensions apply to the flat section of the lead between 0.10 mm and 0.25 mm from the lead tip.
12. A1 is defined as the distance from the seating plane to the lowest point on the package body.
13. N is the number of terminal positions for the specified body size.
14. Values in inches are converted from mm and rounded to four decimal digits.
15. Recommended values and tolerances. DS12766 Rev 3 87/100
